description: Start working in the user's own browser (their logins and cookies) when no tab is shared yet. mode=window (default) opens a separate window for you, so the user's tabs are left alone; every tab you open in it is yours. mode=current asks to use the tab the user is looking at, for tasks about the page they're on. The user approves in a prompt (up to two minutes). Returns the tab handle and a snapshot.

browser.description: Browser key when several are connected.

reason.description: One sentence the user will read, saying what you're about to do.

url.description: For mode=window: the page to open first.

name: start_session
title: Start a browser session
